judgments.reason: Actual database records show coal generation has fallen to 3.41%, confirming it has almost disappeared despite the report's numerical error.
Israel's 16.9% renewables share is significantly lower than Spain's 55.9% and Italy's 48.8%.
An increase of 15 percentage points over 10 years provides no logical basis for reaching over 50% in the next 5 years.
Relying on natural gas for nearly 80% of electricity generation presents a clear data-grounded fuel concentration risk.
